item.title: AWK in 2026: gawk vs mawk vs goawk vs onetrueawk — Which Interpreter Should You Actually Use?
item.description: Your log pipeline runs awk a thousand times an hour. It works on your laptop, then breaks inside a container six weeks later because the image shipped BusyBox awk instead of the interpreter you tested against. No error, no crash — just quietly wrong output in a report nobody reads until the quarter closes.
